fish_species.name: Silver Perch
fish_species.description: A humble fish, content in shallow waters. Snufkin finds their simplicity peaceful.

fish_species.name: Creek Minnow
fish_species.description: Tiny and darting, like silver needles through water. They travel in quiet company.

fish_species.name: Pond Roach
fish_species.description: An everyday companion of quiet mornings. Nothing fancy, but they're always there.

fish_species.name: Rainbow Trout
fish_species.description: Colors shimmer beneath the surface like a quiet promise. Moominmamma would love this one.

fish_species.name: Golden Carp
fish_species.description: Wise and patient, they say these fish remember every season. A gift fit for Moominpappa.

fish_species.name: Sunset Bass
fish_species.description: Orange scales catch the evening light. They only bite when shadows grow long.
fish_species.location_hint: Active at dusk near Moomin House

fish_species.name: Moon Fish
fish_species.description: Pale and luminous, like captured moonlight. Snufkin once wrote a song about them.

fish_species.name: Story Fish
fish_species.description: Its scales shimmer with tales untold. Each one caught brings a memory from the valley.

fish_species.name: Northern Pike
fish_species.description: Fierce and quick. Little My would respect this one's fighting spirit.

fish_species.name: Wanderer's Salmon
fish_species.description: Like Snufkin, it travels far and returns home. A kindred spirit in silver scales.
fish_species.location_hint: Only in spring, when wanderers return

fish_species.name: Hattifattener Eel
fish_species.description: Electric and mysterious, drawn to storms. It glows faintly in deep water.

fish_species.name: Valley Guardian
fish_species.description: Ancient and rare, said to protect the valley's waters. To catch one is to be truly blessed.
fish_species.location_hint: Knows every corner of the valley
